__
 
• The phrase **"fair weather friends"** refers to people **who are only your friends during good times and abandon you in times of trouble**. (सुख के साथी)

 
 
• **Example: **When he lost his job, he realized that most of his so-called friends were just** fair weather friends.**
 
 
 
• **"Adversity"** refers to a difficult or unpleasant situation. (विपत्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **True friends stand by you in times of **adversity.**
